propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket remote without a working git-remote-s3 helper (>=0.3.2) silently corrupts the store by creating multiple bundle files per ref
Store init and push operations must detect S3 mode from the remote URL scheme and fail closed early with an actionable error message before any push attempt
The S3 helper preflight check must raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally, bypassing best-effort delivery semantics, to prevent the corrupting push

The preflight guard must be injected at three call sites: push.py synchronous path (after URL resolution), push.py async arm (in parent before detach), and init.py _mount_or_create_branch after remote resolution
Non-S3 remotes and unresolvable remotes must not trigger the S3 guard, preserving existing behavior and best-effort semantics
